name: A.G.II.D.C. ~RPG Gakuen 2.0 Circus Shijou Saidai no Kiki!?~
original_name: A.G.II.D.C.　～あるぴじ学園2.0　サーカス史上最大の危機！？～
source:
This is the first title by STELLA, a separate brand created from CIRCUS. A thousand years ago, the legendary hero defeated the maou. Now his descendant Masamune begins his own path towards becoming a hero, but then a girl with a great sense of justice wanted to become his disciple. However, she is the descendant of the maou! She creates the ‘Brave Rangers’ (i.e. student council) and drags him along to the dungeon to defeat evil.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau! Omochikaeri~[/url]]
translation:
本作是從CIRCUS獨立出來的品牌STELLA推出的首部作品。一千年前，傳說中的勇者打敗了魔王。如今，他的後裔Masamune踏上成為勇者的道路，卻遇見一名正義感極強、想要拜他為師的女孩。然而，她竟是魔王后裔！女孩組成「Brave Rangers」（也就是學生會），拉著他一同進入迷宮討伐邪惡。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau! Omochikaeri~[/url]]
